title: Artifact
description: The subject of a security analysis submission. v1 invariant: at least one of purl, digests (SHA-256-or-stronger), or content_ref+digests.

purl.description: Canonical Package URL (ECMA-427). MUST be in canonical form.

digests.description: Map of digest algorithm to hex digest. SHA-256-or-stronger is the v1 baseline for new submissions.

content_ref.description: Retrivable content reference. If present, digests MUST contain a matching entry (enforced in submission-create schema).

sbom_refs.description: Supporting SBOM evidence about the artifact or its component graph.
